sample_selection: one deterministic primary tumor from each of eight distinct TCGA cohorts
L0_definition: pure gene_embedding.weight; sample invariant; excludes expression rotary embedding
neighbor_candidates: other genes within the same sample; same-gene cross-sample identity matches excluded by design
limitations: TCGA tumors are biologically diverse but not healthy tissue controls
random controls are degree-quartile matched for pair retrieval and annotation-eligible for neighborhoods
empirical p-values are coarse with 10 null replicates
